statements.statement: Lunenburg expected to net an additional $471,121 in FY27 state revenue based on the conference committee budget, pending the governor's action
additional education funding (Chapter 70) increase in the FY27 state budget
increase in unrestricted general government aid in the FY27 state budget
increase in veterans and elderly exemptions reimbursement in the FY27 state budget
decrease in state-owned land payment in the FY27 state budget
increase in assessments attributable to increased charter school sending tuition in the FY27 state budget
school committee voted (June 24, 2026) to request the select board schedule a special town meeting to appropriate additional state education funding
it has been expressed that teaching positions will not be restored despite the anticipated additional state funding
additional funding expected to go toward the Ignite tutoring program and professional development training on literacy rather than restoring educational staff
classroom sizes would not change regardless of the additional funding, stated several times by school committee members and the superintendent
school committee unanimously voted to request the select board call a special town meeting once the state budget is finalized, to appropriate additional Chapter 70 educational funding
school committee members emphasized that any recurring state education aid should support recurring educational needs such as interventionist and literacy initiatives, tutoring, and staffing
a member advocated that all of the new Chapter 70 funding be appropriated to the school district
